flagged.evidence: The page says, “Under a linear-Gaussian model, positive-definite observation-noise covariances, and a fixed finite horizon, its empirical filter converges to the Kalman filter as ensemble size grows.” The in-scope theorem additionally requires iid initialization from the model prior and independent per-member process and observation draws. The initialization condition is essential: with a scalar one-step model F=H=1, Q=0, R=1, prior N(0,1), and datum y=1, an all-zero initial ensemble has zero sample covariance and zero EnKF gain, so every updated member remains 0, while the Kalman analysis mean is 1/2. The conditions stated in the page sentence alone therefore do not imply its convergence claim.
